card.name: Legong
card.tagline: Refined Balinese palace dance of celestial maidens
card.profile: Legong is a refined classical Balinese dance that probably originated in the 19th century as royal court entertainment (Wikipedia; Britannica). Legend holds that a prince of Sukawati fell ill and dreamed of two maidens dancing to gamelan, and on recovering arranged for such dances to be performed. Traditionally danced by two pre-adolescent girls accompanied by a third attendant (condong), it is marked by intricate finger and hand gestures, rapid footwork and expressive darting eye movements (seledet). The classic Legong Keraton enacts the tale of the East Javanese King of Lasem from the Malat romances. By 1931 Legong had become a marketed tourist performance.
card.insight: Legong is the proving ground for all genres of Balinese women's dance and is among the nine dances within the three Balinese genres inscribed by UNESCO in 2015 (Academia.edu; Jakarta Post).
